proposed_mechanism: Convex capture of persistent cash-session index trends: the H-CW opening-range breakout base leg pays discovery cost; levels 2/3 concentrate exposure only after +1.0/+2.0 ATR of confirmed open profit AND new favourable extremes; a never-widening basket stop (breakeven-plus after level 2, then 1.0x ATR trail) plus a 50%-of-peak giveback stop monetize the right tail of sessions whose trend persists, while the session-flat envelope removes the overnight gap tail a built-out basket fears most. Family A per TAIL_RISK_PROGRAMME_2026-09-16.md section 4 (positive pyramiding, NOT tail-amplifying; contract carried for uniformity).

quantitative_claims.claim: The mechanized H-PY spec passes the deterministic MECHANIZE gate (all required sections, 25 bounded parameters, no runtime model, no external feed, codex_implementable=true).

Pilot motivation only, not proof.
